productionAuthority: Existing life service; display events only.

states.full: lives >= maxLives: count + Full; no countdown
states.refilling: 0 < lives < maxLives: count + time until NEXT life
states.last: lives == 1: same timer, restrained amber count
states.empty: lives == 0: red 0/max + countdown; tapping opens existing Lives flow
states.awaitingConfirmation: Below cap and no valid future deadline: clock + ellipsis; request/reconcile authoritative balance
states.restored: Render confirmed snapshot; play +1 once for one life; update to Full when cap is reached

rules: Settle each failed/confirmed-abandoned attempt at most once. Canceling exit must not settle a loss.
Returning Home, opening Lives and pressing Retry do not deduct again for the settled attempt.
Starting another refill while one is already active must not restart its existing deadline.
Timer reaching zero requests a balance update; the view does not mint a life.
Use synchronized server-time anchor and elapsed monotonic/unscaled time. Refresh on resume; never tick down one second per rendered frame.
Catch-up, cap, offline rules, pricing and refill interval remain existing service configuration.
Animate only a semantic confirmed event once. Do not infer a life loss from any balance difference during page creation.
Do not cap or overwrite a real server balance in presentation code.
